concepts.title: The accounting equation
concepts.appliedScope: Keep assets equal to liabilities plus equity after an event.

concepts.title: Cash accounting versus accrual accounting
concepts.appliedScope: Separate earning, invoicing, expense recognition and cash timing.

concepts.title: Cash and cash equivalents
concepts.appliedScope: Read available cash and distinguish it from profit and receivables.

concepts.title: Revenue recognition
concepts.appliedScope: Record a completed credit sale under the stated case rules.

concepts.title: Trade receivables
concepts.appliedScope: Track invoices, collections and closing customer balances.

concepts.title: Inventory
concepts.appliedScope: Track purchase cost, stock sold and unsold inventory.

concepts.title: Trade payables
concepts.appliedScope: Track supplier credit and settlement timing.

concepts.title: Operating working capital
concepts.appliedScope: Explain why changes in receivables, inventory and payables absorb or release cash.

concepts.title: Operating cash flow
concepts.appliedScope: Reconcile net profit to operating cash flow.

concepts.title: How transactions move through all three statements
concepts.appliedScope: Trace each chosen event across the three statements.

concepts.title: Inventory days, receivable days, and payable days
concepts.appliedScope: Compare collection, stockholding and supplier-payment timing using stated conventions.

concepts.title: Cash budgeting and short-term liquidity forecasting
concepts.appliedScope: Build a dated cash forecast and locate the shortfall.

concepts.title: Liquidity buffers and contingency funding
concepts.appliedScope: Measure funding needed to maintain an explicit minimum cash balance.

concepts.title: Net borrowing
concepts.appliedScope: Separate debt raised from debt repaid and identify future repayment obligations.

concepts.title: Equity issuance, buybacks, and dividends
concepts.appliedScope: Compare equity funding and ownership dilution; buybacks and payout policy are later depth.

concepts.title: Capital expenditure
concepts.appliedScope: Separate equipment cash payment from periodic expense recognition.

concepts.title: Depreciation
concepts.appliedScope: Explain the non-cash charge and its add-back; use supplied depreciation rules.

concepts.title: EBIT
concepts.appliedScope: Distinguish operating profit from financing effects.

concepts.title: NOPAT
concepts.appliedScope: Use operating profit after the stated illustrative operating tax assumption.

concepts.title: Incremental cash flows
concepts.appliedScope: Include only cash flows that change because of the proposed investment.

concepts.title: Present value and future value
concepts.appliedScope: Place cash flows on a timeline and discount the right period.

concepts.title: Net present value
concepts.appliedScope: Evaluate a project at the stated required return.

concepts.title: Free cash flow to the firm (FCFF)
concepts.appliedScope: Reconcile operating earnings, non-cash charges and reinvestment to FCFF.

concepts.title: Weighted average cost of capital (WACC)
concepts.appliedScope: Interpret and use a supplied WACC matched to FCFF; full CAPM estimation is later depth.

concepts.title: Discounted cash flow (DCF)
concepts.appliedScope: Discount explicit FCFF forecasts and an end-of-forecast terminal value.

concepts.title: Terminal growth and terminal value
concepts.appliedScope: Apply supplied sustainable terminal assumptions and require WACC greater than growth.

concepts.title: Sensitivity analysis, scenarios, and reverse DCF
concepts.appliedScope: Compare WACC/growth sensitivities and explain uncertainty; reverse DCF is later depth.

concepts.title: Enterprise value
concepts.appliedScope: Interpret the value of operating assets for capital providers.

concepts.title: Equity value
concepts.appliedScope: Interpret the residual value attributable to equity holders.

concepts.title: The enterprise-to-equity value bridge
concepts.appliedScope: Bridge enterprise value to equity using debt and explicitly excess cash.
